text:
Evan: noticed some risky applies lately where routing flips but a subset of nodes lagged for minutes. proposal: add post-apply verification + quarantine window.
Priya: +1. what's the verification flow?
Evan: after apply returns 200, async verify against a sampled set of workers (10% by default) for a short window (2m). if mismatches > threshold -> mark snapshot=quarantined and do not mark as active.
Noor: UX: console should show "verification pending" then either "verified" or "quarantined (mismatches: N)" with link to details.
Rita: audit-wise every apply must log preview_id + verify_id + trace_id. also ops-only override to force-activate with ticket required.
Evan: example logs we should standardize:
```
cfg_apply snapshot=sh5f3 initiator=evan result=applied verify_id=v7b2
cfg_verify verify_id=v7b2 sampled_nodes=42 mismatches=0 verdict=ok
cfg_verify verify_id=v7c8 sampled_nodes=42 mismatches=3 verdict=quarantined
```
Priya: guardrail thresholds? default: mismatch_count >= 2 -> quarantine for small configs, >=1 for critical configs (origin=prod && affected_routes>50).
Noor: quarantine behavior: keep snapshot in console but do not switch traffic. create incident draft linking traces and top-mismatched keys. page oncall if critical.
SRE: cardinality note: do NOT put verify_id or snapshot_id as metric labels. metrics should be aggregates like `config_postapply_verify_total{result="ok|quarantined|timeout"}`. ids live in logs/traces.
Rita: rollback options: auto-rollback if quarantine persists for >3m or manual rollback via console with reason required. also allow a short ops grace window after auto-rollback where force applies are blocked for 15m.
Evan: add dry-verify endpoint: GET /v1/configs/{id}/verify?cohort=10 that runs verification without applying (useful for canary checks).
Priya: telemetry: counters for verify runs, histogram for verify_latency_seconds, and gauge for current_quarantined_snapshots. keep labels low-cardinality.
Noor: monitoring: if we see >3 quarantines in 24h for same config -> create P1 and attach sampled traces.
Evan: timeline: SRE + Priya to implement minimal metric + verify API by next week; Noor to add console state + CTA the following sprint. ops-bot create ticket CFG-VERIFY-59.
ops-bot: created ticket CFG-VERIFY-59 and assigned to @Priya, @Noor — https://tickets/redwood/CFG-VERIFY-59 :white_check_mark:
Rita: small follow-up: store verification results for 24h by default, archive on request. also surface top mismatched keys in the console details.
SRE: final: rate-limit verify runs to avoid DoS and ensure verification RPCs are low-priority so they don't impact serving SLOs.
Evan: thanks all. we'll iterate on thresholds after some data. follow-up in CFG-VERIFY-59. :rocket:
